question_text: Will there be more than 4  Atlantic hurricanes in 2025?
resolution_criteria:
If the NOAA's National Hurricane Center records more than 4 hurricanes of hurricane category 1 or above between January 1, 2025 and December 01, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market will expire at the sooner of the occurrence of the event, or one day after December 01, 2025.
